відповідь.body: {"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Wool-blend oversized coat in charcoal gray (#36454F), relaxed fit with dropped shoulders and a long hemline reaching mid-thigh, fabric is heavy felted wool for warmth against snow. Silk-blend structured blouse in ivory (#FFFFF0), tailored cut with a crisp collar and a straight boxy silhouette, length hits at the high hip to layer comfortably under the coat. Wide-leg wool trousers in heather charcoal (#606A6E), cropped just above the ankle to avoid bulk over boots, fabric is thick brushed twill for wind resistance. Leather Chelsea boots in matte black (#0F1419), slim shaft hugging the calf with a low block heel for stability on salted sidewalks. Gold-plated geometric hoop earrings in polished brass (#FFD700) and a minimal silver chain necklace to provide the bold statement she requested without sacrificing warmth or professionalism during her twenty-minute walk in freezing, snowy conditions. This outfit works because the heavy wool layers ensure complete protection against -10 °C snow and road salt while maintaining a sleek silhouette that stands out in a sea of winter coats. The cropped trouser length prevents fabric from dragging on icy surfaces, offering practical safety without compromising her desire to make a fashion statement. Finally, the touch of metallic jewelry adds the requested confidence and individuality suitable for a creative workplace environment on a cold morning."}],"usage":{"input_tokens":857,"output_tokens":283},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
